title: appname.perfresult.v1

scenario.description: Part 52 scenario id (PS-1..PS-10); a §34.5 budget-table micro row may also emit this shape

commit.description: git commit hash of the measured build

machineClass.description: §34.5 pinned machine class, e.g. ci-linux-x86; per-class baselines bind (§52.4)

environment.description: §52 environment profile, e.g. env_lowram8, env_remote; absent = default profile

fixtureSeeds.description: seeded-PRNG fixture seeds (§34.5 fixture rules), hex strings

adapter.description: GPU adapter identification; informative (engine-side VRAM accounting is authoritative, §52.4)

samples.description: sample count per §52.4 scenario class: micro = 10 (after 3 warmup), session = 5, cold-start = 5 boots, soak = 1

id.description: metric id, e.g. stall_p95_ms, brush_median_ms, rss_peak_bytes

budget.description: the binding budget for this machine class/tier

histograms.description: histogram arrays are [bucketUpperBound, count] pairs (§52.4); keys e.g. frameMs, stallMs

hash.description: content hash of the baseline, blake3:… (§34.1 content-addressed history)

regressionPct.description: per-metric % regression vs baseline; > 5 % median regression fails (§34.5/§52.4)

baseline.description: absent for a metric's first run: a metric absent from the baseline compares against budget only and is flagged newMetric in the comparer output (§52.4)

x-appname-rule: a PR changing normative behavior updates the document section, this artifact, its tests, and generated docs IN THE SAME PR (Appendix I). JSON cannot carry comments; the Appendix I header block travels as these x-appname-* fields.
x-spec-note: §52.4 publishes a normative EXAMPLE instance ('the CI comparer, the baseline PRs, and the release report all consume this shape and nothing else'), not a JSON Schema — this schema is modeled from that instance plus §52.4's prose (camelCase per §2.8; histogram pair semantics; laddersObserved = §52.3 rung record). The required-field set (schema/scenario/commit/machineClass/samples/metrics) is a modeling choice: every §52.4 example field the comparer needs to identify and gate a run; environment/adapter/histograms/laddersObserved/baseline appear in the example but have documented absent-cases. Metric-row fields are all required (every example row carries all five).
